name: Tempester 1.5.6.0 — fixes and small additions
summary: Fixes and small additions only: every fix of 1.5.1.0 to 1.5.5.0, the dump requests and NRPN, plus stability fixes. No remote panel, project request or beat-wide positions.

fixes: A received SysEx message (even an identity request) no longer corrupts Compare / Undo, and a beat copy no longer corrupts a message being received.
Voices no longer fall silent at random when LFO Restart is set to Play.
A SysEx sent over USB no longer causes lost or stuck notes from a keyboard on the DIN socket.
A SysEx reception that is abandoned closes the Receiving screen instead of leaving the machine looking frozen.
A project message naming a beat above 16 is refused instead of being written outside the project.

description: 1.5.5.0 plus stability fixes: n°16 SysEx rings out of the undo beat; n°17 LFO Restart = Play moved out of Timer 1 (muted voices); n°18 USB SysEx no longer clears the DIN running status; n°19 an abandoned SysEx closes the Receiving screen; n°20 SysEx 5C refused for beat > 15. Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
